text: Angul ଜିଲ୍ଲାର Dasarathpur ନିକଟରେ Mahanadi ନଦୀର ବନ୍ଧ ଭାଙ୍ଗିଯାଇଛି। ପ୍ରବଳ ବନ୍ୟା ଜଳ ମାଡ଼ିଆସୁଛି ଏବଂ 42 ଜଣ ଗ୍ରାମବାସୀ ବନ୍ଧ ଉପରେ ଫସି ରହିଛନ୍ତି।
Severe cyclonic gale winds over 130 km/h in Balasore near Pattamundai. Tin roofs blown away, multiple power lines snapped, roads blocked by fallen branches.
Flood water from Baitarani has submerged Chandipur in Bargarh. Water level reached 5 feet inside houses, 49 persons stranded on rooftops waiting for rescue boats.
Bhadrak ର Brahmagiri ନିକଟରେ ମୁଖ୍ୟ ରାସ୍ତା ଉପରେ ଏକ ବିରାଟ ବରଗଛ ପଡ଼ି ରାସ୍ତା ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ବନ୍ଦ କରିଦେଇଛି। ଆମ୍ବୁଲାନ୍ସ ଯାତାୟାତ ଠପ୍ ହୋଇଯାଇଛି।
Medical emergency in waterlogged Gopalpur, Balangir. Woman in active labor pain, plus an elderly person bitten by venomous krait snake, urgent evacuation required.
Mud and brick house collapsed in Kashipur, Boudh due to continuous heavy monsoon downpour. 4 family members stranded beneath collapsed beam debris.
Cuttack ର Kotpad ନିକଟରେ ପାହାଡ଼ିଆ ଢ଼ଳ ଯୋଗୁଁ କଲଭର୍ଟ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଭାସିଯାଇଛି। ୧୦ଟି ପଞ୍ଚାୟତକୁ ଯୋଗାଯୋଗ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ବିଚ୍ଛିନ୍ନ ହୋଇଛି।
River Tel embankment breached near Padampur village in Deogarh. Flood water surging at high velocity, 42 villagers trapped on embankment.
Severe cyclonic gale winds over 130 km/h in Dhenkanal near Athagarh. Tin roofs blown away, multiple power lines snapped, roads blocked by fallen branches.
Gajapati ଜିଲ୍ଲାର Kamakhyanagar ରେ Brahmani ନଦୀର ବନ୍ୟା ପାଣି ୫ ଫୁଟ ଉଚ୍ଚରେ ପଶିଯାଇଛି, ଘର ଛାତ ଉପରେ 36 ଜଣ ଲୋକ ଫସି ରହି ଡଙ୍ଗା ଅପେକ୍ଷାରେ ଅଛନ୍ତି।

Medical emergency in waterlogged Pattamundai, Jagatsinghpur. Woman in active labor pain, plus an elderly person bitten by venomous krait snake, urgent evacuation required.
